Frequently asked questions

Start with a specific project question

FAQ

Dry-type vs oil-immersed transformer: how should a project choose?

The selection depends on installation location, fire and environmental requirements, voltage and capacity, maintenance conditions and lifecycle cost.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What is transformer K-factor?

K-factor indicates the transformer's ability to carry specified nonlinear load currents without exceeding its thermal limits.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What is the difference between ONAN and ONAF transformer cooling?

ONAN uses natural oil circulation and natural air cooling, while ONAF adds forced air from fans around the radiators.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

Mineral oil vs natural ester: which transformer fluid should be selected?

Mineral oil offers mature performance and broad application, while natural ester provides a higher fire point and improved biodegradability.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What is transformer impedance voltage and why does it matter?

Impedance voltage affects fault current, voltage regulation, load sharing and the ability of transformers to operate in parallel.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What information is required for a transformer quotation?

A useful quotation starts with electrical ratings, application, installation conditions, standards, accessories and required documents.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What transformer is suitable for a data center?

Data center transformer selection usually emphasizes fire safety, harmonic loading, efficiency, reliability, noise and integration with busway or switchgear.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What is an inverter-duty transformer?

An inverter-duty transformer is designed for the electrical and thermal stresses associated with power-electronic converters and inverter-connected systems.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

Cast resin vs VPI dry-type transformer: what is the difference?

Cast resin embeds the winding in a solid resin body, while VPI impregnates the winding insulation with varnish under vacuum and pressure.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What is the difference between OLTC and OCTC?

An OLTC changes transformer taps while energized and carrying load, while an OCTC is operated only when the transformer is de-energized.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What is a transformer vector group?

The vector group identifies winding connections, neutral availability and the phase displacement between transformer windings.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

How does high altitude affect transformer design?

Reduced air density at high altitude affects external insulation, cooling and the performance of air-insulated components.

Read engineering answer →
